Judgment

1 Briefly stated the case of prosecution is that on 27.06.2017 on receipt of DD No.86B regarding death of a lady namely Sangeeta W/o Nand Kishore R/o C534535, Dakshinpuri, New Delhi; ASI Rishi Pal along with Ct. Anil went to Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital.
SI Vishal Tiwari also reached Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital on the directions of the SHO.
Doctor, on duty, informed that deceased Sangeeta was brought to the hospital by her relatives.
After examination, she was declared dead due to hanging.
SI Vishal Tiwari got the dead body of deceased Sangeeta preserved in the Mortuary of AIIMS Hospital.
The SDM, Saket was informed.
On 28.06.2017, inside the Mortuary of AIIMS Hospital, Sh.Adeep Sethia - Executive Magisterate, Hauz Khas, recorded the statements of parents, brother and husband of the deceased.
SI Vishal Tiwari got SC No. 591/2017 State Vs. Nand Kishore & Anr.

sentences.text: It is next argued that the death having taken place within four months of the marriage at the matrimonial home, in circumstances other than natural, makes out criminality against the accused persons.

It is also pointed out that the accused persons had given wrong information to the family of deceased, that she had fallen from the stairs and had sustained injuries; whereas, the death had actually taken place by suicide.
It is further argued that the further steps of investigation has been proved by the official witnesses.
7.1 Sh
.J.S.Basta, counsel for the accused persons has contested the case of the prosecution.
It is argued that the prosecution has failed to prove allegations of any complaint by SC No. 591/2017 State Vs. Nand Kishore & Anr.

the deceased for demand of dowry at any time prior to her death.
At the stage of inquest, no allegations of demand of dowry or specifically motorcycle had been made.
These, came up, much later to the death.
It was only after the family members were instigated by social worker namely Jyoti Gupta (PW14) that the allegations to this effect came on record.
Moreover, the parents and brother (PW1, PW3 & PW 4), who are the prime witness, have not been able to establish any demand of dowry.
It has come up in evidence that someone from the matrimonial home had called up the deceased soon before her death and it was a consequence thereof that the deceased committed suicide.
It is argued that accused Nand Kishore & deceased had been in a relationship for more than 7 years.
Had there been any differences or any demand from the side of accused Nand Kishore, the same would have come up much earlier.
The deceased and accused Nand Kishore were in love with each other and had married after knowing each other for a very long period.
In the absence of any direct evidence of demand of dowry, cruelty for demand of dowry or any instigation for committing suicide, accused persons can not be held guilty.
It is, therefore, prayed that the accused persons be acquitted.

She, thus,

The witness has further deposed that on 15.05.2017, deceased was left behind at the parental home by the accused Nand Kishore and when asked the reason, he said that he would take later.

A study of line of crossexamination by ld. defence counsel indicates that the same is more directed towards the witnesses being tutored or towards the dates.
It may be noticed that no damage could be made as regards the tutoring of the witnesses, when it was suggested that they were tutored by their youngest daughter.

Presence of youngest daughter of witnesses in the court room at the time of deposition would not be SC No. 591/2017 State Vs. Nand Kishore & Anr. Page No. 17 of 26 :: 18 ::
sufficient to draw an inference that they were tutored by her.

sentences.text: She was in any case in their house with them outside the court hours.
Confusion in dates & months has been duly explained by both the parents of the deceased i.e. PW3 & PW4, that they were not very literate.
In any case, the dates of visit of deceased to the paternal home are not in dispute and do not carry much importance, when the entire period of her matrimonial life is shorter than four months.

9.5 It may also be noticed that brother & father of the deceased namely Sh.Sanjay Prasad (PW1) & Sh.Ganga Prasad (PW4) have deposed certain things, which were not directly told to them by the deceased but to their respective wives.
This is acceptable way of communication in the traditional setup where girls do not usually confide in the male members of the family.
9.6 Common thread in the testimony of all the aforesaid five witnesses is that deceased was apparently & evidently not happy at the matrimonial home.
She had visited the parental home around 15.05.2017, when she had come along with her husband accused Nand Kishore to attend the birthday of her brother.
She was left behind by the accused and she stayed at the parental home till the last week of May 2017.
For about two weeks, she was at the parental home.
